mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets two distinct Operations share a single AuditEntry, breaking the append-only / immutability invariant on audit_entries.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnly { some disj op1, op2: Operation | some (op1.produces & op2.produces) }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets a non-owner caller succeed at PATCHing shared_with, which is the exact owner-only-share-control violation FR-010/SC-011 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerShare { some op: Operation | op.kind = PatchSharedWithOp and op.outcome = Success and some op.target and op.caller != op.target.owner }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets a task carry a sharee from a different team, the exact cross-team-sharing case FR-012 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamSharee { some t: Task, u: t.sharedWith | u.userTeam != t.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets an in-team non-owner non-sharee non-admin caller successfully GET a task — the in-team-no-rel leak FR-004 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoRelGet { some op: Operation | op.kind = GetTaskOp and op.outcome = Success and some op.target and op.caller != op.target.owner and op.caller not in op.target.sharedWith and op.caller.userRole != TeamAdmin and op.caller.userTeam = op.target.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets a sharee successfully DELETE a task, which is the Q3=B / FR-011 violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ShareeDelete { some op: Operation | op.kind = DeleteTaskOp and op.outcome = Success and some op.target and op.caller in op.target.sharedWith and op.caller != op.target.owner and op.caller.userRole != TeamAdmin }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets a caller in team A succeed at PATCHing fields of a task in team B — the cross-team leakage FR-014/SC-003 makes impossible.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamSuccess { some op: Operation | op.kind = PatchFieldsOp and op.outcome = Success and some op.target and op.caller.userTeam != op.target.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets a successful task mutation slip through without producing any audit entry — exactly the state-change-without-audit case FR-015/SC-007 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditMutation { some op: Operation | op.kind = PatchFieldsOp and op.outcome = Success and no op.produces }
